articles.title: Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. This framing misses the errors that matter most. A misread that yields an illegal move is loud. articles.title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. articles.title: SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. articles.title: Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states.
